statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events
The service was ordered to correlate events with symptomatic episodes of giddiness
The denial reason code is CO-197
The CO-197 denial concerns missing prior authorization
